behavior: Walks over exposed flats and shallow shorelines, probing soft mud or wet sand and picking invertebrates and small crabs from the surface; often gathers in flocks outside the breeding season.
field_marks: Long, dark bill with a strong downward curve and subtle kink
Dark crown stripes divided by a pale central stripe, with a pale eyebrow
Dark eye crossed by a narrow dark eye-line
Gray-brown upperparts with pale-edged, scalloped feather patterning
Paler buff-gray underparts marked with fine dark streaks
Long gray legs, long pointed wings, and a short finely barred tail
habitat: Breeds on open tundra, moorland, and low wet grassland; during migration and the nonbreeding season uses mudflats, sandy beaches, rocky shores, saltmarshes, estuaries, and other coastal wetlands.
